note: Should-trigger phrasings for every procedure the skill holds: a company's people work (roles, hiring, interview loops, pay bands and offers, onboarding, performance, the people records, a wellbeing program), the profile interview absorbed from identify (interview, confirm and facet-named, and the proactive case of a thin facet), and the user's own career and skills and health and wellbeing. Near misses are a neighbouring department's requests phrased close to this one's: a company-wide headcount call or the user's goals (administration), payroll in the model, the money in an offer or a health plan election (finance-and-accounting), employment contracts (legal-and-compliance), the user's job search and pay negotiation (sales-and-marketing), research about a framework, user research interviews and a new agent seat (research-and-development), charting the user's sleep (business-intelligence), household routines (operations-and-logistics), the user's prose (public-relations), checking a document before it goes out (quality-assurance) and cancelling a membership (customer-experience). Used by the description trigger check.
